description: SPIN3 GNSS - Servizio di Posizionamento Interregionale GNSS is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by spingnss.it. The SPIN3 Interregional Positioning Service is the result of the collaboration of Regione Piemonte, Regione Lombardia and Regione Autonoma Valle d'Aosta. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "SPIN3 GNSS - GNSS Interregional Positioning Service" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include sistemi di coordinate, RNDT, RTK, RDN, GNSS, sistema di riferimento. The listing shows 1 download or service links in OTHER. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
